summary_en: E-Guardian Inc. will acquire 100% of Pentio Inc.'s shares to make it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The acquisition targets Pentio's authentication and access control solutions (OneLogin and SecureW2) to accelerate cybersecurity business growth and establish comprehensive security services from external threat prevention to internal access control.
title_en: Notice Regarding Execution of Stock Transfer Agreement for Acquisition of Pentio Inc. Shares (Complete Subsidiary Status)
translation_en_brief:
E-Guardian Inc. announced on November 12, 2026, that its board of directors resolved to execute a stock transfer agreement to acquire 100% of Pentio Inc.'s shares and make it a wholly-owned subsidiary. The acquisition price and timing of transaction closure were not disclosed in the notice.

Pentio specializes in authentication and access control solutions, including OneLogin (IDaaS) and SecureW2 (PKI/RADIUS), with established expertise in integrating foreign security products with complex Japanese corporate systems and strong customer relationships. The company recently entered a sales partnership with U.S.-based Obot AI to extend its authentication coverage to AI agents.

E-Guardian expects to create synergies through cross-selling authentication solutions to its existing customer base and its own services to Pentio's customers; combining Pentio's technical proposal capabilities with E-Guardian's sales resources to improve operational efficiency and profitability; acquiring Pentio's foreign security product distribution rights and integration know-how; strengthening high-margin recurring revenue models by leveraging the high retention characteristics of authentication and identity management platforms; and establishing a unified system from product deployment to operations by combining Pentio's solutions with E-Guardian's 24/7/365 operational expertise. Pentio's CEO Haruhiko Hasegawa will continue to participate in management, while E-Guardian's Ushio Naito will serve as Pentio's vice president.
